levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد

notes: Rule 11: Ali ibn Yaqtin narrates an encounter in which the Imam Musa speaks and acts (the lion over the table). Whether the Imam is the source or only in the scene is not settled: no Imam link is added and the ruling is left open
«أخيه الحسين» and «أبيه علي بن يقطين» are named by relation plus name, so each link is the name alone
«رضي الله عنه» is a blessing and is left out
